name: bughouse-analysis
description: Bughouse game analysis in the browser with the hivemind engine

paragraphs: A public bughouse analysis board in the spirit of lichess's game analysis: import a chess.com bughouse game (or set up both boards by hand) and review it with the hivemind engine. Every move gets a judgement (inaccuracy, mistake, blunder), each player an accuracy score, and the game an evaluation graph.

The engine runs on the visitor's machine. Its search is compiled to WebAssembly and the neural network runs on the GPU through WebGPU, or on the CPU when WebGPU is unavailable. The browser always runs the newest twin-s-clock.onnx from aminwoo/bughouse-twin-s-clock, the networks trained to play on real clocks. The only server-side code is a small proxy that fetches games from chess.com.
features: Import from chess.com: paste a game link or id; the partner board is found
automatically and both boards are merged into one timeline by clock times.
Set up any position: edit both boards, reserves, side to move and how far each team is up on time.
Two-board analysis board: play moves and drops on either board to explore
variations; clocks, reserves and last moves are shown per board.
